title: Deep Chats question
description: One question card in the compendium. Each file in data/ must match this schema; init.py validates every file before building the site.

id.description: Unique identifier. The file must be named <id>.json.

question.description: The question shown as the card title.

description.description: A short note on why this question works.

related_id.description: Ids of related questions. Every id must resolve to an existing file.

tags.description: Tags used to group and filter questions.
